{"diagnosis":"Batch 13 has an extra partial re-delivery (max ingest_ts 22:00 vs the usual 02:00). It re-sent about 20 txn_ids, and the raw table has 4847 rows for 4827 distinct txn_ids. silver_transactions has no dedup, so 18 POSTED txn_ids appear twice. The fix keeps the latest delivered row per txn_id, then filters to POSTED.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.72,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS
SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id,
       customer_id,
       CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id,
       CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount,
       CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts,
       CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date
FROM (
  SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn
  FROM raw_transactions
) r
WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
